name: RenewalUpliftPlanner
tagline: Renewal Uplift Planner helps account managers and renewal desks price a subscription, support or licence renewal.
description: Renewal Uplift Planner helps account managers and renewal desks price a subscription, support or licence renewal. It compares a flat renewal, the standard uplift and a multi-year price lock side by side, checks the price increase against the contractual cap, shows how the quantity change, uplift and multi-year discount move the value, and lays out every year of the new term with its dates and total contract value. The year-1 renewal value is saved to the record.
features: Multi-year lock and Custom scenario cards, term (years)
Price uplift % with the contractual cap
Price lock for multi-year terms with a per-year discount
A value bridge (current, quantity, uplift, discount, year 1)
A year-by-year schedule with renewal dates
Notice-window and approval checks (Ready / Needs approval / Blocked)
